pages.title: Read the Compass
pages.text: The Yin-Yang Compass shows Yin Qi and spiritual Qi. Compare numeric readings rather than color alone. Map locations have coordinates and can be pinned as targets; keep the compass in hand to see your position and navigation on the HUD.

pages.title: Follow the Bearing
pages.text: After pinning a point, follow its X/Z, bearing, distance, and coordinate offsets while moving. There is no need to reopen the map every few steps. Pins belong to the current world; confirm a new target after changing dimension or save.

pages.title: Spiritwood Groves
pages.text: Natural Spirit Wood Trees gather in Overworld Spiritwood Groves. Search newly generated temperate forest terrain; explored land does not change biome automatically. Collected saplings may be planted, subject to their growth conditions.
